param.name: channel_axis
param.label: Channel axis. if None, channels dimension is attempted to be automatically determined.
param.help: Channel axis. if None, channels dimension is attempted to be automatically determined.

param.name: z_axis
param.label: Z axis. if None, 2 dimension is attempted to be automatically determined.
param.help: Z axis. if None, 2 dimension is attempted to be automatically determined.

param.name: diameter
param.label: Estimate of the cell diameters (in pixels).
param.help: Estimate of the cell diameters (in pixels).

param.name: flow_threshold
param.label: Flow error threshold (all cells with errors below threshold are kept) (not used for 3D).
param.help: Flow error threshold (all cells with errors below threshold are kept) (not used for 3D).

param.name: cellprob_threshold
param.label: All pixels with value above threshold kept for masks, decrease to find more and larger masks.
param.help: All pixels with value above threshold kept for masks, decrease to find more and larger masks.

param.name: flow3D_smooth
param.label: If do_3D and flow3D_smooth>0, smooth flows with gaussian filter of this stddev.
param.help: If do_3D and flow3D_smooth>0, smooth flows with gaussian filter of this stddev.

param.name: min_size
param.label: All ROIs below this size, in pixels, will be discarded. Defaults to 15.
param.help: All ROIs below this size, in pixels, will be discarded. Defaults to 15.

param.name: max_size_fraction
param.label: Masks larger than max_size_fraction of total image size are removed. Default is 0.4.
param.help: Masks larger than max_size_fraction of total image size are removed. Default is 0.4.

param.name: niter
param.label: number of iterations for dynamics computation. if None, it is set proportional to the diameter.
param.help: number of iterations for dynamics computation. if None, it is set proportional to the diameter.
